_comment: UAE -> Italy email matchers. THE ONLY ROUTE WITH REAL OBSERVED MAIL (two messages, 2026-08). Everything the base config knows was extracted from these; this file adds only what is Italy-specific.
_comment_sender: MEASURED, not assumed. A live pass over the real mailboxes on 2026-09-02 found every VFS message came from donotreply@vfshelpline.com (115) or donotreply@vfsglobal.com (8) — NOT from the info.italyuae@ address printed in the body's signature block. Pinning the signature address would have matched nothing. The bare domains are therefore what is pinned; the local part varies and must not be relied on.

matchers.name: waitlist_invitation
matchers._comment: Overrides ONLY from_contains — subject_contains, body_contains, extract and validity_hours all survive from _default.
matchers._comment_body: THE COUNTRY DISCRIMINATOR, and it is load-bearing. Every country's mail shares the same subject and near-identical wording, so without it one country's email matches another's matcher (routes are tried in sorted order) and inherits the wrong validity window — silently applying the wrong deadline. The portal URL is the only part of the message that names the country unambiguously.

matchers.name: waitlist_confirmation
matchers._comment: Only the country discriminator. The MESSAGE TYPE is already pinned by the inherited subject_contains ('Successfully Added to Waitlist'), so a second body phrase would add nothing — entries inside one condition are alternatives (OR), not extra requirements, so listing 'has been successfully registered' here would LOOSEN the match rather than tighten it: any Italian mail would then qualify on the URL alone. Conditions AND across kinds (subject AND from AND body); alternatives OR within a kind.

_comment_reference_format: Italy's Unique Reference Number is ITD125298020335 — a 3-letter prefix, unlike Switzerland's 4-letter SWDB79923880977. The base's "([A-Z0-9-]+)" covers both deliberately; do not narrow it here.
